7619: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back to a plank.
Lower your chest to the floor and push up, or skip the push-up if you prefer.
Jump your feet back toward your hands.
Jump up, spreading your arms and legs like a jumping jack, then repeat.
7620: Set bands on the bar and lie on a flat bench with your feet planted.
Unrack the bar over your chest with a firm grip.
Lower it to your mid chest under control.
Press up and out until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pinched and your feet down.
7621: Set the pins at a height just above your chest and lie on the bench.
Grab the bar at about shoulder-width plus a little.
Pause the bar on the pins to remove momentum.
Press the bar straight up until your arms lock out.
Lower back to the pins with control and reset for each rep.
7622: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest one heel on the wall with your leg as straight as feels comfortable.
Keep the other leg flat on the floor.
Relax and breathe, letting the hamstring lengthen.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch legs.
7623: Stand beside a wall and place one hand on it above head height.
Press your hips away and lean your chest down toward the floor.
Feel the stretch along your side and under the armpit.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.
7624: Start in a low lunge with your front foot between your hands.
Lower your forearms to the floor or blocks.
Drop your back knee or keep it lifted.
7625: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, elbows fixed.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
7626: Hold the end of the landmine bar against your chest with both hands.
Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest tall.
Squat until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Drive through your whole foot to stand back up.
7627: Hold the end of the landmine bar at your shoulder.
Step one foot back into a lunge.
As you rise, press the bar overhead.
Lower the bar to your shoulder while you lunge back again.
Complete your reps and switch legs.
7648: Hold a dumbbell in the hand on the same side as your standing leg.
Shift your weight to that leg with a soft knee.
Hinge at the hips and reach the weight toward the floor.
Extend the other leg straight behind you.
Return to standing by squeezing your glute.
Finish all reps, then switch sides.
7693: Sit tall on the floor, leaning back slightly with your hands behind your head.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Twist and bring one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Return to centre and repeat on the other side.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.
